name: Virginia Attorney General
description: The Attorney General shall have exclusive authority to enforce the provisions of this chapter (§ 59.1-584(A)) and is empowered to issue civil investigative demands where there is reasonable cause to believe a violation has occurred, is occurring, or is about to occur (§ 59.1-583). Nothing in the chapter provides a basis for a private right of action (§ 59.1-584(E)).
